title: Integral Secant Distributions and Improved Bounds for Complete (k,n)-Arcs
description: This preprint develops sharp integer bounds for the numbers of maximal secants through the points of a complete higher arc and its complement. The method refines the classical incidence bound on the classified rational equality families with integral limiting degrees and, after modular repair, proves the asymptotic lower bound k >= q^2/3 + 4q/3 - o(q) for complete (k,2q/3+1)-arcs in PG(2,q) over q=3^h.
